text: Based on the Earth-observation evidence, the 2023 loss was not caused by storm damage. The data shows that the loss area was 4.5 hectares, primarily consisting of planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda). There is no direct indication of storm damage in the observations. The loss could be due to other factors such as logging, disease, or fire. Additional information would be needed to determine the exact cause of the loss.
